paragraphs: Charlotte Bronte was an English novelist and poet, the eldest of the three Bronte sisters who survived into adulthood and whose novels became classics of English literature.
She first published her works under the pen name Currer Bell, and her best known novel appeared in October 1847 to immediate critical attention across London.
Her later novel Villette appeared in 1853, drawing on the year she spent teaching in Brussels, and she died on 31 March 1855 at the age of thirty-eight.
title: Charlotte Brontë
